boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Hillsdale College spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, research, student services, and campus events, verified through current official sources.

cards.entity_name: William L. and Berniece E. Grewcock Student Union
cards.title: Settle Into a Union Lounge
cards.subtitle: Lounges, games, mailboxes, dining, and student offices under one roof
cards.notes: Choose a lounge or conference room for studying, or meet friends near the fireplace, ping-pong tables, and student mailboxes.
cards.short_summary: The central union supports both informal study and everyday campus connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale describes Grewcock Student Union as a gathering place with lounges and conference rooms for study, games, student mailboxes, publication offices, and student-service offices.
cards.source_title: The William L. and Berniece E. Grewcock Student Union
cards.access_notes: School-year building hours are listed as 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily; individual offices and services may keep different hours.

cards.title: Take the Arboretum Trails
cards.subtitle: A campus-edge natural area with ponds, gardens, gazebos, and reading spots
cards.notes: Enter during daylight for a trail walk or bring a book; use the ponds, waterfall, gardens, and stone gazebos as landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A 48-acre natural area gives students room to read, walk, and attend outdoor events.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies Slayton Arboretum as a 48-acre natural area where students read and attend events, with trails, two ponds, a waterfall, gardens, and stone gazebos.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; event spaces may require reservations.

cards.title: Borrow Gear and Head to Hayden Park
cards.subtitle: Trails, fields, courts, disc golf, and seasonal outdoor recreation
cards.notes: Walk to the park for trails or field activities; students can check out mountain bikes and, in winter, cross-country skis.
cards.short_summary: The college-owned park expands student recreation well beyond the central campus lawns.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale states that Hayden Park contains trails, intramural fields, sand volleyball courts, disc golf, and other recreation, with mountain bikes and cross-country skis available to students.
cards.access_notes: The park is about a half mile from the main campus; equipment availability and activity-specific access should be confirmed locally.

cards.title: Use the North Quad Between Classes
cards.subtitle: The central lawn north of Central Hall
cards.notes: Bring reading or lunch to the grass, or use the open lawn for a casual game while staying clear of scheduled campus activities.
cards.short_summary: This central green functions as an outdoor study, meal, play, and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes North Quad as a place where students gather, study, eat, play, and spend time outdoors.
cards.access_notes: An outdoor campus lawn; temporary events, maintenance, and weather can affect use.

cards.title: Build a Research Base at Mossey
cards.subtitle: Collections, research services, computers, and extended weekday study hours
cards.notes: Start at Mossey for books, databases, research help, or a study session; check the library site for construction and special-hour changes.
cards.short_summary: The main library combines broad collections with research help and late weekday access.
cards.evidence_claim: Mossey Library provides nearly 300,000 physical items plus electronic resources, special collections, research services, and school-year hours extending to 1:00 a.m. on several nights.
cards.access_notes: Listed school-year hours: Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–9:00 p.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m., and Sunday 1:00 p.m.–1:00 a.m.; verify special hours.

cards.title: Try the Fishbowl for a Working Session
cards.subtitle: A windowed seminar room facing the Quad and library colonnade
cards.notes: Use the chalkboards and natural light for collaborative work, but confirm the room is not reserved for a class, club, or library session.
cards.short_summary: The glass-walled seminar room supports study, instruction, and club gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: An official Hillsdale student-life article identifies the Fishbowl as a Mossey Library seminar room used for classes, librarian sessions, club events, and student study.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Mossey Library; availability depends on library hours and scheduled classes or events.

cards.title: Study Among the Heritage Collections
cards.subtitle: A Mossey Library room for research, rare books, artifacts, and displays
cards.notes: Use the room for library-based study and research, respecting display cases and furnishings; groups should reserve it through library staff.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive library room pairs quiet research use with historic collections and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Mossey Library says the Richardson Heritage Room's primary purpose is study and research using library resources and provides a reservation process for groups.
cards.access_notes: Inside Mossey Library; group reservations require library approval, and the room cannot accommodate gatherings over 75 attendees.

cards.title: Work Beside the Mises Collection
cards.subtitle: A second-floor library room containing Ludwig von Mises's personal library
cards.notes: Visit for economics-focused research or a change of study setting, and ask library staff before handling special or archival materials.
cards.short_summary: This named room places student study alongside a major economics collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale states that the Ludwig von Mises Room houses the economist's personal library and makes the collection available to Hillsdale faculty and students.
cards.access_notes: Located on Mossey Library's second floor; access follows library hours, while special materials may have handling restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Fred A. Knorr Memorial Student Center
cards.title: Use Knorr for Academic and Career Tasks
cards.subtitle: Computer labs, academic support, career services, radio, and a student lounge
cards.notes: Head here for computer access, academic or career assistance, then use the student lounge while waiting for an appointment or collaborator.
cards.short_summary: Knorr gathers practical academic services and an informal student space in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Knorr Center houses computer labs, Career Services, Volunteer Services, a student lounge, and WRFH Radio Free Hillsdale.
cards.access_notes: School-year building hours are listed as 7:30 a.m.–midnight daily; service offices and labs may have separate schedules or eligibility rules.

cards.title: Watch the Campus Calendar for Searle
cards.subtitle: A large event center containing Plaster Auditorium
cards.notes: Check the campus event listing for lectures, concerts, dinners, or student occasions here; enter only when the scheduled event permits.
cards.short_summary: Searle is a shared destination when major lectures, performances, and formal campus events convene.
cards.evidence_claim: Hillsdale identifies Searle Center as a primary event location and says its Plaster Auditorium hosts lectures and concerts, while the building also holds campus dinners and other events.
cards.access_notes: Event-based access; admission, registration, seating, and opening times depend on the specific scheduled program.
